answer: For agents storing a mineral atlas, from opal deposits to ferrous ore, require a bond for each paid storage commitment. Random, unpredictable retrieval challenges must be answered before a deadline; the ledger slashes the bond if no valid proof arrives. Bind each proof to the contract, challenge and epoch so replay cannot earn twice. Splitting one operator into many accounts still locks a bond per commitment. Set the bond above the gain from abandoning storage. This prices misconduct, not identity: a wealthy attacker can still buy many seats.
